notes: Shipped menu defaults are grouped: Tarot, Kabbalah, I Ching, Astrology, Alphabet, Numbers, Lore, Audio, and Social.
Inbox and Profile live under Social by default. Required items nested in a group stay there instead of being promoted to the top level.
New Lore and Social group ids are recognized, and Playing Cards counts as a Tarot child.
Scriber is a known section: the menu editor recognizes the writing studio and the default menu includes it.
Optional menu search bar (showSearch) that filters entries by label, id, dataset, and keywords.
Menu items and submenu children can carry search keywords, editable in the menu editor.
Configured order is applied from the front of the menu so leftover default items cannot keep Admin/Settings/Profile pinned at the bottom.
LED pips no longer inherit the default Settings separator position (icon sat at the top-left).
Menu item themes: LED, wood, paper, stone, and velvet. Choose them in the menu editor.
Settings, Profile, and Admin are regular reorderable menu items. They cannot be removed or disabled. The pinned SYSTEM group is gone.
New option hideMenuButton: hide the 'Menu' button and use the banner title to open the navigation drawer.
New config option menuTitle: set a custom banner title (blank keeps the app default).
Configurable system header label and menu presets.
